NEW: 🇨🇭 Switzerland gets its first spot Bitcoin ETF as BIT Asset Management's BBIT starts trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange. The structure matters. Most European Bitcoin products are debt notes carrying issuer credit risk, while BBIT is a FINMA-approved fund holding physical Bitcoin in cold storage at AMINA Bank, ring-fenced from the manager. It launches with 350 BTC, a 0.19% target fee and trading lines in USD and CHF. FINMA signed off on Oct. 20 after an 18-month review. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2126337694158459363

NEW: 🇺🇸 A bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law now heads to the full House after the House Financial Services Committee formally reports it. It bars the government from selling, swapping, auctioning or encumbering its Bitcoin for at least 20 years and requires proof-of-reserve reports. Addresses linked to the U.S. government hold 306.8K BTC, worth over $18.7B, per Arkham. Time is short: this Congress ends January 3, and Polymarket gives a national reserve under 5% odds before 2027. Without the bill, a future president can undo Trump's executive order alone. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125990010159571011

NEW: 🇺🇸 Eric Trump's American Bitcoin takes a $150M credit line from FalconX, secured by its own Bitcoin. The two-year revolving facility carries a 5.95% loan fee and a 143% initial collateral ratio, so every $1 drawn needs about $1.43 in pledged BTC. CEO Mike Ho calls it non-dilutive capital, letting the miner fund growth without selling from a reserve of more than 8.5K BTC. ABTC jumps 17% Monday to about $4.09, yet the stock is still down roughly 84% this year. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125628434059592060
